prompt: automake parallel make recovery locking portable test-and-set command
answer:
Use `mkdir` as the portable test-and-set operation:

```make
          trap 'rm -rf elc-lock elc-stamp' 1 2 13 15; \
          if mkdir elc-lock 2>/dev/null; then \
            rm -f elc-stamp; \
            $(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) elc-stamp; \
            rmdir elc-lock; \
          else \
            while test -d elc-lock; do sleep 1; done; \
            test -f elc-stamp; exit $$?; \
          fi
```

A successful `mkdir elc-lock` identifies the first process; other parallel processes wait until the lock directory disappears, then succeed only if `elc-stamp` exists. The Automake manual notes that locking solutions still violate the `make -n` promise, and portable parsing of `MAKEFLAGS` is not easy.
